releaseNotes: Teacher app 1.13.11: built-in crash reporting. If the app ever stops on a phone, it now sends the exact error to the developer automatically on the next open - so problems get fixed precisely instead of by guesswork. Also includes 1.13.10's fix for phones where a corrupted data file made the app stop right after opening. Updates cleanly over previous versions (same signature, no uninstall needed).
